about: Codes a pasted W_ROOM_NO_FIXTURE / W_ROOM_MISSING_DEFINING hint set was measured to gain, with the rule that emits each (PR #216, plan-soundness PS2.17). Measured with the set verification off, pasting every quoted set into its plan: the A+B fuzz corpora (PS2.9's, 1,413 sets) and every single-storey corpus .arch (102 sets), under the default ruleset, accessibility-advisory and residential-basic; plus W_FIXTURE_BACK_TO_ROOM, measured on f7d6f6d before the corner-rotation fix (17 of 687 fuzz kitchen sets). Review round 4 added the multi-room fuzz (test/lint-hint-paste.test.ts's corpusMulti: four rooms on a corridor, kitchens beside baths, doors and openings between neighbours; seeds 99 and 515, 300 plans each, 4,561 sets): it gains W_PATH_TOO_NARROW and W_WET_ROOM_DOOR again and W_CIRCUITOUS_PATH (seed 99: 6 sets under default and residential-basic, 5 under accessibility-advisory; first at plan 117), a set closing the way through a room. PS2.69 added W_EXIT_APPROACH_BLOCKED: test/lint-fix-texts.test.ts's W_ROOM_NO_FIXTURE plans (the half-walled bathroom under the default ruleset; the kitchen and the half-walled bathroom under accessibility-advisory) quoted a set standing in the clear floor inside their exterior door. The rules flagged readsFurniture in src/ are exactly these.
